meta.title: Low Sun
meta.key: E Phrygian: Em7, Fmaj9, Em7, Dm9
meta.words: v2: the steel drum and the toms are now native; otherwise as v1. Phrygian, dark and a little mysterious: E minor 7, F major 9 (the half-step above), E minor 7, D minor 9. Tribal toms and shaker, a kalimba pattern, a steel drum in threes, the soft sequence on the round bass, dotted chords.
